title: Later Skunk Works boss on Astra

tellings.quote: He said, "Oh, it hasn't flown yet."

plain: Sometime in the mid 1990s, at an aviation trade show, a man who would later run Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design unit of the company Lockheed, is said to have answered a question about a craft called Astra by saying, "Oh, it hasn't flown yet." The aviation journalist Nick Cook tells this as something he heard himself. If true, it would suggest that Astra was a real project being built in secret.
